title: 🔥资金回流BTC避险主导
body: 市场结构处于深度防御状态。BTC.D为58.1%，7日变化+0.2%。在BTC价格7日下跌10%的背景下，市值占比反而微升，证实资金正从山寨币抽离回流至大饼避险。当前仅为存量资金的防御性轮动，并无增量入场信号。中性。流动性枯竭何时结束？
title_en: 🔥 Capital Rotation to BTC Dominates Risk-Off Play
body_en: Market structure is in deep defensive mode. BTC.D sits at 58.1%, with a 7-day change of +0.2%. Despite a 10% drop in BTC price over the last week, its dominance has actually inched up. This confirms capital is fleeing altcoins and rotating back into BTC for safety. Currently, this is purely defensive rotation of existing capital—there are no signals of fresh inflows. Neutral. When will the liquidity crunch end?
